post.text: NZ Parliament @NZParliament Nov 25, 2020 We had 12 languages spoken by MPs in the Commission Opening of Parliament today, including English, Te reo Māori, Mandarin, Samoan, Tongan, Rotuman, Korean, Dutch, Cantonese, Arabic, Sanskrit and Cook Islands Māori. Rachel Brooking (she/her) @BrookingRachel Nov 25, 2020 Hey @NZParliament how many languages were spoken in today’s swearing in of the 53rd Parliament!
